spans.s:
A dual case affix ending in ई or ऊ or ए is called प्रगृह्य , or excepted vowels which do not admit सन्धि or conjugation.

Terms:

The final ई and ऊ of words giving the sense of the locative case are प्रगृह्य।

Terms:
After all the feminine नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी

etc., words ending in a short इ and उ , आम् is substituted for the इ of the Locative -7th case singular.

Terms: नदी विभक्ति

ष् is substituted before a hard guttural or a labial for the विसर्ग which is preceded इ or उ and not part of an affix.

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
